summary:
Bank/strategist coverage this window: 8 kept items across 3 banks out of 60 tweets scanned; the remaining 52 were MikeZaccardi's untagged intraday price/chart commentary, dropped as noise per the routine's filter. Goldman dominated with 6 items spanning household balance-sheet strength (real estate + equity holdings near $80T, bankruptcy filings below pre-pandemic norms), mortgage market health (2.2% negative equity, 4% in-the-money for refi), domestic box office (+12% YoY), and a Dow-mover note tagging $GS. BofA flagged deposit-account data pointing to strengthening low-income job growth in July. JPM (JPMAM) highlighted unusually fast consumer AI adoption. No Neil Sethi (@neilksethi / @neilksethinew) activity appeared in this window.

By bank: Goldman 6, BofA 1, JPM 1.
